integrity: The proof reduces extension coordinates to proper colorings of the exact minimum-distance Cayley graph, classifies maximum cocliques and cliques structurally, and is independently replayed by an exhaustive finite verifier for all 64 message labels and all resulting partitions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one-coordinate eight-symbol extensions of the explicit base code under the broad Hamming-isometry equivalence used by the source. It does not assert uniqueness under additive, monomial, or semilinear equivalence and does not address multi-coordinate extensions.
title: All one-coordinate extensions of Alderson’s \( (30,2,24)_{8/2} \) counterexample
